name: PriceListItems
technicalDescription: Read-only mirror of customer / site price lists. The price list is the source of truth for price disputes.

columns.name: priceKey
columns.description: Unique price key (priceListCode + sku + site + validFrom)

columns.name: customerCode
columns.description: Priority customer code when the list is per customer (text link to Customers)

columns.name: siteName
columns.description: Site name when the price is per site

columns.name: source
columns.description: Data source: priority-mock, priority-file (uploaded Priority export), priority-api, or test-fixture (marked test data, removed by DeleteTestFixtures)

columns.name: syncedAt
columns.description: When this row was last loaded from Priority / the bank file
